description: This file defines the VaultRepository class, which manages database operations related to 'vault' items, including CRUD operations, search, encryption/decryption of sensitive data, and retrieval methods for vault entries within a PHP project.

classes.name: VaultRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling Vault entities, including insertion, deletion, search, and encryption/decryption operations within a database context, extending a base MySQL repository.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new Vault record into the database with encrypted value data.

methods.name: deleteByIdAndUserId
methods.description: Deletes a vault item based on its ID and user ID.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Constructs a base SELECT query for general vault data.

methods.name: getFullSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Constructs a full SELECT query including all vault data fields.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for vault items based on provided criteria, optionally returning full data.

methods.name: getVaultItemName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a vault item by its ID and project ID.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Finds all vault items within a specific project.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Finds all vault items accessible by a specific user.

methods.name: readVaultItem
methods.description: Reads and decrypts a specific vault item using its ID and a password.

methods.name: updateVaultItemById
methods.description: Updates a vault item identified by ID, decrypting existing data and encrypting new data if provided.
